decision_conditions: The proposed development by virtue of the substandard floorspace for flat 2 and poor layout of flat 1 which would lend itself to no outlook and minimal light serving the living room, would represent a substandard and inappropriate form of accommodation which would not be capable of meeting the reasonable needs of occupiers and would be detrimental to the residential amenities of future occupants. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP4 of the Enfield Plan Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD5, DMD8 and DMD37 of the Development Management Document (2014), the Mayor of London Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance, The Technical Housing Standards-Nationally Described Space Standards and Chapter 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026).

The proposed first floor rear access over the flat roof, by reason of its siting, scale, and relationship with neighbouring properties, would result in an elevated external area that enables direct and prolonged overlooking into neighbouring gardens and habitable rooms, along Park Avenue. The development would result in an unneighbourly form of development, causing an unacceptable loss of privacy and residential amenity, contrary to Chapter 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), Policies DMD 8, DMD 9, and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), and Core Policy 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010).
description: Conversion of single family dwelling house into 2 self-contained flats involving single storey rear infill extension and relocation of existing external metal staircase to rear (PART RETROSPECTIVE).
